info.name: Slekto Agency API
info.description:
Third-party agency integration for creating and monitoring campaigns on the Slekto LED display network.

**Quick start:**
1. Run "1. Get Token" first — it saves the token automatically
2. Run "Create Campaign" and note the `campaign.id` in the response
3. Paste that ID into the `campaignId` collection variable
4. Run "Get Campaign Analytics" to see live metrics

variable.description: Base URL of the Slekto API server
Bearer token — set automatically when you run '1. Get Token'
Campaign ID to query analytics for — set this after creating a campaign

formdata.description: Name of the client company being advertised
Number of ad placements (max 25 total across all active campaigns)
Upload 1–20 ad image files (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP — max 10MB each). Click 'Select Files' to attach.

request.description:
Creates a single-playlist **rotation** campaign. All uploaded images cycle together on every assigned bag.

**After running this request**, the `{{campaignId}}` variable is automatically set to the new campaign's ID, ready to use in the analytics request.

**Required fields:**
- `company_name` — the client you are creating the campaign for
- `start_at` / `end_at` — campaign date range (ISO 8601)
- `hours_bought` — total playback hours
- `bags_bought` — number of ad placements (1–25)
- `images` — attach one or more image files

**For multiple playlists under one campaign** (e.g. 12/5/5 bag splits across different creatives) use the **Create Campaign (Split / Multi-Playlist)** request below.

formdata.description: Name of the client company being advertised
Use 'split' for multiple playlists under one campaign

JSON array (≥ 2 entries). Each entry: {label, bags, hours, image_count}. The sum of image_count values must equal the number of files you attach in 'images'. Images are consumed in upload order: first image_count → playlist 0, next → playlist 1, etc.
Attach ALL images for ALL playlists here, in order. With the default playlists value (2+1+1=4), attach 4 files: first 2 belong to Creative A, next 1 to Creative B, last 1 to Creative C.

request.description:
Creates a **split-mode** campaign with multiple playlists sharing one campaign record. Use this when a client wants dedicated bag/image allocations per creative — e.g. 12 bags for Creative A, 5 for Creative B, 5 for Creative C.

**How images map to playlists:**
Images are consumed from the `images` field in upload order. Each playlist's `image_count` decides how many of the next unclaimed images it owns. The sum of all `image_count` values must equal the number of files you attach.

**Defaults in this request** declare 3 playlists with `image_count` 2/1/1 = 4 images total. Attach 4 image files in that order.

**Response shape** includes the same top-level `campaign` object as rotation mode plus a `playlists[]` array with per-playlist `program_id`, `label`, `bags_assigned`, `hours_bought`, and `files_uploaded`.

**Completion semantics:** each playlist completes independently when its own `hours_bought` is delivered; the parent campaign only flips to `completed` after ALL playlists finish.

After running, `{{campaignId}}` is set and the **Get Campaign Analytics** request will return per-playlist metrics.

request.description:
Returns all campaigns created by this agency account, newest first.

Use this to look up a campaign ID if you did not store it at creation time.

query.description: Other values: planned, paused, completed, cancelled

request.description:
Returns only active campaigns. Change `status` to filter by:
- `planned` — not yet started
- `active` — currently running
- `paused` — temporarily paused
- `completed` — all hours delivered
- `cancelled` — cancelled

Returns real-time analytics for a specific campaign.

**Before running:** Set the `{{campaignId}}` collection variable to the campaign ID you want to query. This is done automatically when you run Create Campaign (Rotation) or Create Campaign (Split).

**Response shape:**
- `analytics` — campaign-level roll-ups across every playlist (`hours_played`, `hours_bought`, `completion_percent`)
- `playlists[]` — per-playlist breakdown: `label`, `bags_assigned`, `hours_bought`, `hours_played`, `completion_percent`, `share_of_voice_percent`, `media_urls`, `completed_at`, per-playlist `files` counts

Rotation-mode campaigns return a single-entry `playlists` array; split-mode campaigns return one entry per playlist. Each playlist completes (and its creatives are removed) independently once its own `hours_bought` is delivered — the parent campaign status flips to `completed` only after all playlists finish.

**Security:** You can only access campaigns your agency created. Attempting to access another agency's campaign ID returns `404`.
